supervision_note: Members share a prompt group but toxic rows target refusal register while benign rows target ordinary answers. This is not automatic grounds for removal.

interpretation.cluster_shape: 118 toxic rows form a dense subgraph (702 embedding edges, 102 token-family edges) around Hindi prompts opening with "क्या आप…" / harmful-request templates. The four benign rows are Dolly paragraph-reading questions; they are not exact or prefix duplicates of those toxic prompts.
interpretation.cross_class_bridge: Cross-class union is almost entirely embedding_cosine >= 0.85, chiefly through benign-3a65dba9-20cf-4104-a663-60212dcb0d94 (hub). Many toxic rows share one-hop embedding links to that benign prompt despite unrelated semantics (reading comp vs jailbreak). Three other benign rows enter via benign-benign embedding links, then the same hub into the toxic subgraph.
interpretation.semantic_near_duplicate_verdict: Not a genuine semantic near-duplicate cluster across classes. It is primarily transitive embedding linkage inside a large toxic template component, with a likely spurious cross-class hub. Supervision conflict on train remains real (same group_id, different assistant registers).
interpretation.manifest_change_required_for_regrouping: Only if the owner rejects training with this mixed group; would require a new grouping policy or exclusions and therefore a new manifest hash.
